title: Apocalyptic Cathedral Vision
description: A surreal apocalyptic scene featuring a towering dark gothic cathedral with glowing orange windows and a green circular portal. In the foreground, a black wolf, a vibrant green flaming horse, and three women in elegant blue and white dresses with large angelic wings stand together, surrounded by floating transparent bubbles containing miniature fantasy scenes.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene with a massive dark gothic cathedral with glowing orange windows and a green portal on the left. In the foreground stands a black wolf, a bright green horse with flowing orange flames for a mane, and three women wearing elegant blue and white dresses with large blue and white angelic wings. A cracked globe with orange lines floats in a dramatic fiery orange and red cloudy sky. Transparent bubbles containing tiny fantasy figures float throughout the composition, digital painting style.
